Name: Golden Goose Mayonnaise
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
Did you ever want to make Golden Goose Mayonnaise with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]? Now you can! This mod was inspired from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url] I just wanted to make super special Golden Goose Mayo.

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/K9pAGk8.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KMQmOT3.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WJY3wnv.png[/img][/center]
